basic_info.headline: Senior System Software Engineer at Lumafield
basic_info.about:
I'm a seasoned software engineer with 15+ years of experience in
security and backend systems, recently expanding into full-stack
development. With a Ph.D. in Computer Science from the University of Washington
I bring deep technical expertise to complex challenges.

My focus spans both security engineering and backend/systems
development, with expertise in Python, C/C++, and Linux/Unix
environments. Recently, I've added TypeScript and Angular to my
skillset, broadening my capabilities across the full development
stack.

In my recent role at Instrumental, I've gained full-stack experience
internationalizing the company's main application and quickly solving customer
problems.  I also led ITAR compliance efforts by eliminating
critical vulnerabilities.

At Zebra Technologies, I co-architected a Python framework for
contract manufacturing and implemented network services including
DHCP, DNS, and SSH key distribution. I also developed tools that found
100+ critical vulnerabilities in robotics systems and created an AWS
security scanning infrastructure.

During my eight years at Citrix, I co-architected their Application
Firewall protection against SQL injection and XSS attacks, designed
distributed hash tables for session management across multiple
machines, and implemented multiprocessor solutions for systems with
non-shared memory. I also led debugging efforts to isolate memory
leaks and performance bottlenecks in their enterprise platform.

I thrive on solving complex technical challenges with a methodical
approach informed by my academic background and industry experience.
I'm also an active contributor on Stack Overflow (top 6%).

Named co-inventor on 11 patents | Ph.D. Computer Science | Stack
Overflow Top 6% Contributor

experience.title: Cyber Security Consultant
experience.description: At Whisker, I played a pivotal role in enhancing the security posture by surveying source code and AWS environments for vulnerabilities. I developed automation scripts to facilitate security scans and manage Jira tickets, ensuring a streamlined process for addressing security issues. My efforts led to the identification of critical vulnerabilities and improved reporting for management oversight.

experience.title: Software Engineer (Station)
experience.description:
Title: Station Software Engineer

I am part of the team responsible for developing the software powering
Instrumental's Station, a critical tool used by manufacturers to identify
and address defects on production lines. This software encompasses both the
operating system and the user-facing application, enabling operators
to seamlessly inspect objects and analyze defects in real time.

Projects included:

* Internationalized both the server and client side of the Station
  application using the i18next (Typescript) and ngx-translate (Angular) libraries.
  In the application, users can dynamically change the application's language.
  Managed the translation of hundreds of strings in three languages.

* Designed and implemented a framework and example application for connecting
  the Station to a variety of customer MES backends. The framework allows
  non-Station engineers to easily write code to interface to new MES backends.

* Leading effort to identify, track and fix security vulnerabilities across all first-
  and third-party software used by Instrumental.  This effort is key to satisfying
  Instrumental's contractual obligations to customers.

experience.title: Senior Software Engineer
experience.description:
* Co-architect and implementor of framework to enable contract manufacturing for the F100 robot series.
       * Blueprinted SQL database schema for storing testing infrastructure data and results.  Used 
           SQLAlchemy ORM library.
       * Implemented services needed for the standalone test server, not limited to DHCP, DNS, package 
          mirrors, and an SSH key distribution system.  Test server has been 100% reliable in production.
       * Created a server system monitor that sent service alerts via Slack API.

* Architected and implemented a system to find and report security vulnerabilities in Docker images from 
   third party libraries.  The project found nearly a hundred critical vulnerabilities, and hundreds more. 
       * System ingested the latest Docker images from a variety of projects.
       * Images were scanned using an open-source image scanning tool.
       * Using Atlassian’s JIRA API, filed and managed tickets to upgrade libraries to address vulnerabilities
       * Generated detailed Confluence web page pages with scanning results.
* Worked with development teams to measure and improve test coverage.
* Interfaced with development teams to improve product security

experience.title: Software Engineer
experience.description:
* Analyzed and solved core product DNS server issues found by customers.
* Rewrote subscriber services network handling code.
* Wrote network trace dissector program to analyze customer traces for debugging purposes.

education.degree: Bachelor's Degree, Electrical Engineering and Computer Science
education.activities: Member of Tau Beta Pi and Eta Kappa Nu honor societies.

volunteering-experiences.description: I'm a regular platelet donor at Stanford Blood Center.   Platelets are a blood component that is separated out from whole blood during a procedure that lasts from 90 to 120 minutes.   I've done this over 200 times over the years.
